svg.title: Only one platform in the matrix clears every requirement without a caveat, and Anthropic Managed Agents is a binary fit, not a partial one.
svg.desc: Eight requirements — sub-60-minute synchronous runs, multi-hour batch, sandbox forking, GCP fit, AWS/VPC fit, zero-infra hosted harness, GPU support, and vendor lock-in — are scored against six platforms: Cloud Run service, Cloud Run job, Fargate, Anthropic Managed Agents, LangChain Deep Agents Deploy, and Kubernetes Job. Deep Agents Deploy is the only column with no unsupported or caveated cell. Managed Agents is hosted-only and Claude-only, so it either fits a workload completely or not at all.

text.font-family: Space Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: No single green cell decides the architecture — the caveated cells usually do.
